Maya: Heads-up — Solaris Health enrolled 5 seats in the preview but only one active user this week. Risk: renewal in 6 weeks. Need quick re-engage.
Noah: Got it. Which roles are quiet?
Maya: 2 PMs, 2 analysts inactive. Only an engineer used the API.
Iris: I can run a 25m "analyst lab" focused on extracting insights from logs + a 10m PM outcomes sync. Quick wins only.
Noah: Good. Also propose a 2-question pulse to the enrolled list: 1) what's the blocker? 2) prefer lab or sync?
dev-bot: Sandbox created: solaris-beta-sandbox (expires in 9 days).
Maya: Owners: Iris - run analyst lab (Wed 3pm), Noah - send pulse & buyer outreach, Maya - update playbook + tag renewal risk if no change in 10 days.
Noah: Draft outreach copy for buyer: 
```
Hi — quick check: noticed some teammates haven't tried the preview. Would a short 25m analyst lab or 10m PM outcomes sync help? Pick a time: <cal.link/solar-lab>
```
Iris: Lab agenda: 1) goals (2m), 2) demo (8m), 3) hands-on (12m), 4) next steps (3m). Sharing notebook after scheduling.
Maya: If after sessions we don't get +2 active users within 7 days, plan B = 1:1 engineering pairing to drop-in a snippet. Escalate to AE.
Noah: Pulse sent. First response preferring the lab. Scheduled Wed 3pm.
Iris: Will tailor dataset to their schema and post notes in playbook.
Maya: Paste this playbook template: 
```
Outcome: attended / no-show / follow-up scheduled
Active seats after: (n)
Key blockers: (list)
Agreed success metric: (e.g., 3 active users within 7 days)
Escalation path: AE + eng pairing
Owner + due date:
```
Noah: I'll update Gainsight if no usage bump in 10 days.
Maya: Thanks team — tight follow-up. :white_check_mark:
